method: PROVEN: CODE 0 jump table $52 maps to CODE 1 $118; CODE 1 $118-$14e uses nonnegative D0 as an index for loaded SOUN resources. CODE 1 $24a-$2a4 loads SOUN resources by those IDs. Records are literal linear-disassembly call sites, not verified runtime reachability; embedded data may disassemble as instructions and unreachable or unaligned code may be missing.
offset_convention: CODE segment body offsets exclude the four-byte segment header.
